title: 第3833章 偷袭失败第3832章 不养无用闲人
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 他们虽不知公子给的丹药究竟是什么，但觉得公子没有理由害他们。
他们选择吞下丹药，不仅是因为公子的要求，也是为了确保万无一失。
毕竟他们可不想死，也不想承担风险，因此他们决定孤注一掷。
吞下丹药以后，顿时之间，他们体内传来了剧烈的突破声音。
轰隆！！
轰隆！！
轰隆！！
一阵声响过后，他们体内修为都开始松动，实力暴涨起来，直接连破了三层。
刹那之间，他们大喜若狂，惊喜无比。
然而那滚滚的药力还在体内翻滚，打通了一根根经脉，将他们往更高的层次推！
要是平常，根本突破不了这么多境界，这丹药药性真是无敌了。
一时之间，他们心头大喜，感觉如获新生。
锦袍男子也欣喜万分，比他们几个还要兴奋。
他兴高采烈的炫耀道：“看到了吧，如今我的这些手下修为都提升了三个层次，想要捏死你，简直比捏死一只臭虫还要简单，你就等着见阎王吧！”
听到这话，苏长歌淡淡一笑，不以为然，懒得解释，心想现在对方有多么神气，到时候就有多么的失望。
随后，四名随从纷纷动手，背后浮现可怕的求道玉，阴阳之力浓缩成黑色权杖，漆黑的权杖将他们衬托的如天神屹立虚空，每一人都凶威滔天，气势恢宏。
锦袍男子露出得意的笑容，这可是四位大帝强者，他坚信对方肯定接不住！
只见苏长歌嗤笑一声，一副淡定自若的模样，压根没放在心上，不知道的还以为没看到。
“臭小子，你怎么还不出手，是不是知道打不过，所以干脆就放弃了？”一名随从得意的嘲讽道。
苏长歌微微一笑，正色道：“我的人生信条里就没有后悔，放弃这种字眼，只有弱者才会后悔和放弃。”
另一名随从不屑的道：“说的比唱的还好听，等尝了我们的手段，看你还能不能说出这种话来。”
紫月冷哼一声，嘲讽道：“你们四个打一个，有什么好得意的，不觉得羞耻吗？就算赢了也是胜之不武，不过嘛没有这种可能。”
锦袍男子笑了笑，满不在乎的道：“胜之不武又如何？过程不重要，只要结果达到了就行！”
他不在意过程，只在乎结果，至于够不够光明正大，都是扯淡。
“出手吧！”
content_en:
Although they didn't know what the elixir given by the young master was, they felt that the young master had no reason to harm them.
They chose to swallow the elixir not only because of the young master's request, but also to ensure that nothing went wrong.
After all, they didn't want to die or take the risk, so they decided to go all-in.
After swallowing the pill, a violent breakthrough sound suddenly came from their bodies.
Boom! !
Boom! !
Boom! !
After a burst of noise, the cultivation levels in their bodies began to loosen, and their strength surged, breaking through three levels in a row.
In an instant, they were overjoyed and surprised.
However, the rolling medicinal power was still rolling in the body, opening up the meridians and pushing them to a higher level!
Normally, he wouldn't be able to break through so many realms. The medicinal properties of this elixir are truly invincible.
Suddenly, they were overjoyed and felt like they had been reborn.
The man in the brocade robe was also very happy, even more excited than the rest of them.
He showed off happily: "You see, now my subordinates' cultivation has improved by three levels. It's easier to crush you to death than to crush a bug. Just wait until you see the King of Hell!"
Hearing this, Su Changge smiled faintly, disapprovingly, and was too lazy to explain. He thought that how proud the other party was now, how disappointed he would be then.
Then, the four followers took action one after another, and the terrifying Dao Seeking Jade appeared behind them. The power of yin and yang was condensed into a black scepter. The dark scepter made them look like gods standing in the void. Each of them was fierce and majestic.
The man in brocade robes showed a proud smile. These were four powerful emperors. He firmly believed that the other party would not be able to catch them!
Su Changge sneered, looking calm and composed. He didn't take it to heart at all. Those who didn't know thought they didn't see it.
"You brat, why don't you take action? Do you know you can't beat me, so you just gave up?" A follower mocked proudly.
Su Changge smiled slightly and said seriously: "There is no regret in my life creed. Only the weak will regret and give up."
Another follower said disdainfully: "What you say is better than what you sing. Let's see if you can still say such words after you try our methods."
Ziyue snorted coldly and said mockingly: "You four are fighting one against the other. What's there to be proud of? Don't you feel ashamed? Even if you win, it will be a weak victory, but there is no such possibility."
The man in brocade robes smiled and said nonchalantly: "So what if we win without using force? The process is not important, as long as the result is achieved!"
He doesn't care about the process, he only cares about the results. Whether it's fair or not is all nonsense.
"Take action!"
